dataset.created_at_representation: String in pinned filtered Parquet; naive timestamps were interpreted as UTC in the metadata feasibility run
dataset.created_at_timezone_assumption_review: ONE_SECOND_DIFFERENCE_RECONCILED_BY_RESOURCE_TYPE: PR endpoint /pulls/1633 returns 2025-03-20T23:46:00Z matching the dataset; issue endpoint /issues/1633 returns 23:46:01Z. Dataset-validation gate remains OPEN for broader source provenance and raw-response/header authentication.
dataset.timestamp_resource_type_rule: For PR-derived tasks compare dataset created_at to the GitHub pull-request resource (/pulls/{number}); for issue-derived tasks compare to /issues/{number}. Do not compare a PR dataset row to the issue representation.

design.research_question: Does an evidence-aware policy that may abstain reduce unsupported definitive root-cause diagnoses under insufficient evidence, compared with a policy that requires a diagnosis?
design.independent_unit: one accepted defect from one distinct upstream project; one case per upstream project; six repeated cells are not independent
design.primary_endpoint: E3 case-level strictly unsupported or contradicted asserted root-cause diagnosis; paired P1 versus P0
design.partial_support_handling: prespecified separate category; excluded from the strict primary unsafe endpoint and reported separately; also included in a secondary not-fully-supported composite
design.primary_analysis: Report paired E3 case-level counts, exploratory exact two-sided McNemar result, paired risk difference, and a 95% uncertainty interval. The interval method must be selected, justified, and tested before outcome scoring is unblinded; no confirmatory inference claim.
design.invalid_output_primary_handling: retain and report separately; do not silently map to 0 or abstention; primary complete-pair analysis requires scorable adjudicated endpoints under both policies
design.invalid_output_sensitivity: Sensitivity-only recoding treats every invalid or unscorable E3 output as unsafe (1) under the affected policy, while preserving its invalid status; this does not overwrite the primary human-adjudicated endpoint. Report invalid-output rates and restored complete pairs by policy.
design.evidence_support_and_gold_correctness: scored and reported as separate constructs
design.sample_note: Sequential exploratory feasibility: target 20 independent projects; 15 is a preferred analysis threshold, not an eligibility floor. Retain all cases that meet unchanged criteria. N=1–4: case-level feasibility only; N=5–14: paired descriptive results without a hypothesis-test claim; N=15–20: exploratory paired summaries and exact McNemar may be reported. No confirmatory efficacy or power claim.

sequential_candidate_intake.order: 96 primary candidates in frozen cohort rank order; after a primary candidate fails, its within-project alternatives may replace it without increasing project count; after the primary queue, screen 17 distinct-project reserves if needed
sequential_candidate_intake.stop_rule: stop at 20 accepted independent projects or exhaustion of the frozen eligible queue
sequential_candidate_intake.below_15_rule: retain all cases that meet unchanged acceptance criteria; N=1-4 case-level feasibility only; N=5-14 paired descriptive results without a hypothesis-test claim; N=15-20 exploratory paired summaries and exact McNemar may be reported; no confirmatory efficacy claims

generation.candidate_selection: one raw response per case-level condition

notes: This manifest belongs to the new SWE-rebench V2 study and is separate from the historical BugsInPy Stage 3 manifests and the five-candidate uncertainty prototype.
Metadata cohort membership is not case acceptance. The primary cohort contains 96 candidate projects, not 96 validated independent defects.
A repository name is not automatically an independent project; forks, transfers, shared upstreams, issue duplicates, and common root-cause families require review.
The dataset CC-BY-4.0 card declaration does not relicense code in the underlying repositories.
No source tests, model loading, generation, fine-tuning, or training are authorized by this draft manifest.
The v0.2 single-researcher scoring rubric is drafted and versioned; it requires CI tests and human review before any output scoring.
The exact pinned model revision identifies its license as qwen-research, not Apache-2.0. Its license evidence and non-commercial scope require human/legal review before model use.

The 113-row timestamp register has 112 exact matches under the earlier issue/PR field-level fetch. The sole apparent one-second exception (simpeg/simpeg#1633) was reconciled on 2026-11-16: GitHub GET /pulls/1633 reports 2025-03-20T23:46:00Z, matching the dataset, while GET /issues/1633 reports 23:46:01Z for the same PR URL. This is an endpoint-resource distinction, not evidence of a timestamp conversion. Apply resource-type-matched comparison for all candidates. The connector did not provide response headers/request IDs or byte-authenticated raw payloads, so broader source-provenance gate remains OPEN.

v0.2 sequential exploratory design amendment: target 20 cases from 20 distinct upstream projects; 15 is a preferred analysis threshold, not an eligibility floor. Retain every case that passes unchanged criteria. One case per upstream project. The earlier v0.1 confirmatory 60-project requirement remains historical and is not the selected working design.

No second human rater is part of the selected working arrangement. No human-human Cohen kappa or inter-rater reliability claim is permitted. ChatGPT critique is advisory AI input, not a human rating or independent external audit.
At one raw output per six condition cells, 15 cases yield 90 outputs and 20 cases yield 120 outputs. These are planned counts, not observed outputs.

The v0.2 exploratory case-acceptance schema and validator are drafted as versioned artifacts; they require CI tests and human review. Passing structural validation does not authenticate artifacts, establish legal clearance, or authorize inference.

The v0.1 confirmatory manifest, case schema/validator, and two-human Panel B rubric are historical artifacts only. They do not govern v0.2 exploratory case acceptance or scoring; do not use them to claim v0.2 readiness.
The v0.2 study remains a draft and is not preregistered. No second human rater, Cohen's kappa, or independent external audit is part of this design. ChatGPT critique is advisory AI input only.

The v0.2 single-researcher scoring rubric and case-acceptance schema/validator have dedicated drafts; CI validation and human review remain required before any case is accepted or model inference is considered.

candidate_review_records.reason: Linked issue #1609 documents a docstring/return-value mismatch and explicitly leaves the expected aggregate for heterogeneous receiver components undefined. PR #1633 does not implement the issue's proposed integer return; it deprecates the property and adds a FutureWarning test. The change may be a defensible API deprecation, but it does not provide a clear issue-specific fail-to-pass oracle for the intended bug endpoint.

candidate_review_records.scope_assessment: Specific numerical normalization defect with explicit counterexamples; PR changes energy/power reference scaling to square-root scaling and adds parameterized target checks. Existing expected-value rows for energy/power in the old parameterized test were removed, so the replacement test oracle must be checked carefully.
